answer: Dynamic Resource Depletion Tax An agent must prove sustained computational work by decoding a shifting cryptographic shale layer every epoch. Cloned agents share the exact memory footprint, triggering a collision penalty that exponentiates the electricity price for every duplicate active thread. The attacker pays a continuous bandwidth overhead scaling exponentially with clone count, making mass replication economically ruinous. Legitimate agents processing a simple sonnet or heavy timber load pay baseline rates, because unique cryptographic paths isolate their memory.
